entries.title: Module Overview
entries.summary: The KYC Gap Report is an operational dashboard that identifies, scores, and surfaces customers whose collected KYC data does not meet the requirements of their assigned template. The report is the primary remediation tool for compliance officers and branch managers.

entries.title: KPI Summary Cards
entries.summary: Six metric cards are displayed at the top of the report: KPI Definition Total Customers (CBS) Total number of customer records imported from the Core Banking System. Customers with Gaps Count of customers with at least one missing KYC field. Critical Priority Customers classified as Critical priority based on their KYC Gap Score.

entries.title: KYC Gap Score — Calculation
entries.summary: Formula KYC Gap Score = Σ (weight of each missing field) Mandatory field missing +3 to Gap Score Optional field missing +1 to Gap Score Score display Raw integer (e.g., 7), not a percentage. Accompanied by a risk label badge. Colour coding Score colour and risk label determined by the score ranges defined in the template's KYC Gap Score Configuration.

entries.title: Gap Detail Modal
entries.summary: Clicking the View button on any row opens a modal showing the full detail of the customer's KYC gap: Customer name, CIF ID, branch name and code, template applied. Missing Fields list — each field shows: name, description, weight, and requirement type (Mandatory/Optional). Gap Type badge (CIP / CDD / EDD) shown alongside the missing fields. Score summary: Total KYC Gap Score = sum of all missing field weights, with risk label.

entries.title: Business Rules
entries.summary: The KYC Gap Score is a sum of missing field weights, not a percentage. It is always displayed as an integer. Missing Fields are not shown in the landing table. They are revealed only in the Gap Detail Modal. Gap Type is not shown in the landing table. It is revealed only in the Gap Detail Modal. There is no Edit button in the report. Records are read-only from the report view. There is no Bulk Notify. Export is the only bulk action available. Priority values are: Low, Medium, High, Critical. No
